sample_unit: individuals in external PROCOAC cohort (1609 instances)

links.outcome: Recalibration of model to correct prevalence shift in external cohort
links.effect: Logistic recalibration corrected prevalence shifts; after recalibration the sensitive threshold gave NPV 0.875 and sensitivity 0.804, the high-specificity threshold PPV 0.610 and specificity 0.941.

links.outcome: Net benefit of chosen decision thresholds via decision curve analysis
links.effect: Decision curve analysis showed positive net benefit at both the sensitive screening and high-specificity thresholds, supporting a three-tier risk stratification framework.
links.quote: Decision curve analysis showed positive net benefit at both thresholds, supporting a three-tier risk stratification framework.

screen.reason: Pure model-development and retrospective external validation study for predicting rapid pain progression in knee osteoarthritis; does not evaluate deployment, clinical workflow, or safeguards in practice.
